result.title: JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: The performance of language agents depends jointly on model weights and the harness. Optimizing either alone can be constrained by the other component, limiting overall performance gains. Our analysis of naive alternating training reveals progressive incompatibility between the model and harness, which increasingly interferes with task execution and may also undermine model training, leading to performance degradation. To coordinate the evolution of models and harnesses, we introduce JoMoHa, to our knowledge the first framework to jointly train an executable harness generation policy and a task execution policy through reinforcement learning. JoMoHa outperforms the evaluated weight-only and harness-only baselines and achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods on ALFWorld, WebShop, and DBBench, averaging 70.3% and reaching 97.0% on ALFWorld. By learning both task execution and runtime improvement from its own generated trajectories, JoMoHa performs recursive self-improvement (RSI).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 JoMoHa，用强化学习联合训练可执行的 harness 生成策略与任务执行策略，以协调语言 agent 的模型权重和运行时框架，并在 ALFWorld、WebShop、DBBench 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 把 harness 作为可学习、可生成的控制结构并与执行策略共同优化，可能为 LVR 中「THINK/LOOK/STOP」等推理控制及训练监督提供方法线索，但需核查其 harness 表示是否涉及视觉证据筛选与停止决策。
